question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is: **whom**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Grammatically, 'whom' is the correct option because it is the object of the preposition 'of' in the phrase 'half of whom.'
 
• 'Whom' is used to refer to the people who received the experimental vaccine, and it is in the objective case because it is the object of the preposition.
 
• The other options are not appropriate because 'whose' is used to show possession, 'what' is used to refer to things or ideas, and 'which' is used to refer to things or animals.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **whom**.
